title: motilal_wcs_16_2006_11.txt
rule: Blue Chip Buy Signal #2: Buy Blue Chip stock when Dividend Yield > 3.0%
entry: Buy blue-chip quality stock whenever its trailing Dividend Yield crosses above 3.0%.
exit: Hold long-term for mean reversion as price appreciates and yield normalizes.
conditions: Applied to blue-chip stocks where standard average yield is around 1.5%. A yield >3% signifies deep correction or step-up dividend.
data_needed: Stock price and declared annual dividend data.

title: motilal_wcs_16_2006_11.txt
rule: Potential Blue Chip 5-Factor Fundamental Screen
entry: Select and buy stocks meeting all 5 quantitative filters: (1) Uninterrupted annual dividends for last 5 years, (2) EPS increase in at least 3 of last 5 years, (3) Dividend increase in at least 2 of last 5 years, (4) Minimum RoE >= 15% in ALL 5 individual years, (5) 5-year PAT CAGR >= 10%.
exit: Hold multi-year as potential blue chip transitions into recognized blue chip status.
conditions: Market Cap <= Rs 10,000 Crore (INR 100b) classified as Potential Blue Chip; Market Cap > Rs 10,000 Crore classified as Recognized Blue Chip.
data_needed: 5-year annual historical EPS, Dividend per share, RoE, PAT growth rate, and Market Cap.

title: motilal_wcs_16_2006_11.txt
rule: Blue Chip Extreme Overvaluation Sell Signal (P/E ~40x & Dividend Yield <= 0.3%)
entry: Re-enter position only after stock valuation corrects back below its 10-year median P/E.
exit: Sell entire position in blue-chip stock when P/E expands drastically (e.g. 4x expansion up to ~40x P/E) and Dividend Yield drops to extreme lows of <= 0.3%.
conditions: Applies to blue-chip stocks experiencing euphoric multi-fold price expansion divorced from dividend yield dynamics.
data_needed: Historical P/E trajectory and Dividend Yield historical levels.

title: motilal_wcs_17_2007_12.txt
rule: 8-Year Sector-Relative RoE Persistence Screen (Economic Moat Filter)
entry: Pichle 8 saalon me se kam se kam 6 saal tak jis company ka Annual RoE uske Sector Average RoE se adhik ho, unka portfolio bana kar buy karo
exit: 10 saal tak hold karo ya jab tak company ka RoE sector average se niche na chala jaye
conditions: Company RoE > Sector Average RoE in >= 6 out of past 8 financial years
data_needed: fundamentals (Company Annual RoE and Sector Average RoE for past 8 years)

title: motilal_wcs_18_2008_13.txt
rule: Emerging Value Creator 6-Step Quantitative Screening Model: Company age < 25 years + First time RoE > 15% + PAT >= Rs 10 Crore + Non-Cyclical business + Trailing P/E <= 20x
entry: Screen on annual financial results release when company age < 25 years, RoE crosses 15% for the first time in past 10-15 years history, PAT >= Rs 100 million (Rs 10 Cr), and Trailing P/E <= 20x.
exit: Hold for 5 years or exit if RoE drops consistently below 15%.
conditions: Company incorporation age < 25 years, 1-year RoE > 15% (first time ever), PAT >= Rs 10 Cr, exclude cyclical sectors (metals, sugar, real estate, commodities), Trailing P/E <= 20x.
data_needed: Annual balance sheet, annual PAT, RoE history (10-15 years), incorporation date, daily OHLCV for P/E calculation.

title: motilal_wcs_18_2008_13.txt
rule: Optimized Emerging Value Creator Strategy (with 3 Performance Amplifiers): Emerging Screen + High Industry Profit Pool + B2C Consumer Advantage + Top 3 Market Leadership
entry: Apply base Emerging Value Creator filter (Age < 25 yrs, First time RoE > 15%, PAT >= Rs 10 Cr, P/E <= 20x), and select only those meeting all 3 amplifiers: (1) Industry aggregate PAT is in top 50% of corporate sectors, (2) B2C business model (Consumer Advantage), (3) Top 3 market share rank in its category.
exit: Hold for 5 years.
conditions: Base Emerging Screen criteria + High Profit Pool sector + B2C model + Top 3 market share rank.
data_needed: Annual financial fundamentals, market share data, sector PAT data, P/E ratio.

title: motilal_wcs_18_2008_13.txt
rule: Enduring Value Creator 5-Step Fundamental Screen: 10 Consecutive Years RoE > 15% + 3-Year PAT CAGR > 15% + 5-Year RoE Delta > 0 + Trailing P/E <= 30x
entry: Buy stocks that satisfy: (1) RoE > 15% for each of the last 10 consecutive years, (2) 3-year PAT CAGR > 15%, (3) RoE in year T > RoE in year T-5 (5-year RoE Delta > 0), (4) Trailing P/E <= 30x.
exit: Rebalance annually or exit if RoE drops below 15%.
conditions: 10-year continuous RoE >= 15%, 3-year PAT CAGR >= 15%, RoE_t > RoE_{t-5}, trailing P/E <= 30x.
data_needed: 10-year historical annual financial statements (PAT, Networth/RoE), daily price data for P/E.

title: motilal_wcs_18_2008_13.txt
rule: Market Outperformance Wealth Creation Filter: 5-Year Stock Price CAGR > 5-Year Benchmark (Sensex) Price CAGR
entry: When screening wealth-creating portfolios or stock universes, strictly eliminate any stock where 5-year Price CAGR <= 5-year Sensex Price CAGR, regardless of absolute market cap generated.
exit: Screening filter only.
conditions: Stock Price 5-Year CAGR > Sensex 5-Year CAGR.
data_needed: 5-year historical stock price CAGR and Sensex 5-year price CAGR.

title: motilal_wcs_18_2008_13.txt
rule: Macro Equity Bottoming & Favorable Allocation Screen: Corporate Profit / GDP <= 4.5% AND Market Cap / GDP <= 61%
entry: Go aggressive long on index / broad market equities when Corporate Profit to GDP ratio falls to/below 4.5% AND Market Cap to GDP ratio is <= 61%.
exit: Reduce equity allocation when Market Cap to GDP ratio exceeds 100%.
conditions: Corporate Profit / GDP <= 4.5% and Total Market Cap / GDP <= 61%.
data_needed: Annual GDP data, aggregate corporate profits, total market capitalization.

title: motilal_wcs_18_2008_13.txt
rule: Sector Overvaluation Avoidance Filter: Sector P/E > 2x Market Average P/E par long positions avoid karo; capital ko reasonable valuation (P/E ~ market average) + high PAT CAGR + high RoE wale sectors me rotate karo.
entry: Jab target sector P/E market average P/E ke close (e.g. 19x vs 15x) ho aur sector PAT CAGR + RoE overall market se zyada ho tab allocation karo.
exit: Jab sector P/E overall market average P/E se 2x se adhik ho jaaye ya earnings growth stagnant ho jaaye.
conditions: Avoid sectors with P/E > 2x Market average (e.g., Consumer at 33x vs Market 15x). Allocate to sectors like Tech (P/E 19x with high PAT CAGR and RoE).
data_needed: Sector P/E, Market Average P/E, Sector PAT CAGR, Sector Average RoE

title: motilal_wcs_18_2008_13.txt
rule: PSU Sectoral Exclusion Filter: Screening me Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) ko filter out karo, visheshkar Utilities, Metals & Mining, aur Capital Goods sectors me.
entry: Private sector peer stocks me entry lo jahan 5-year Sales CAGR > 20%, PAT CAGR > 20%, aur RoE > 20% ho.
exit: number nahi diya
conditions: PSU overall PAT CAGR (7% vs Private 21%) aur RoE trajectory (20% down to 14%) severely lag private companies. Limit PSU exposure strictly or avoid completely outside Oil & Gas / Financials.
data_needed: Company Ownership (PSU vs Private), Sector, Financial Performance Metrics

title: motilal_wcs_18_2008_13.txt
rule: Base Market Cap < INR 5 Billion (Rs 500 Crore) Return Multiplier Setup: Multi-year outperformance ke liye base market cap < INR 5 Billion (< Rs 500 Cr) wali growth companies ko select karo.
entry: Base year Market Cap < INR 5 Billion (Rs 500 Crore) ho aur company high sales & earnings growth report kar rahi ho.
exit: 5 years holding period ya jab target market cap re-rating achieved ho jaaye.
conditions: Base market cap INR 1-5b delivered 65% Price CAGR compared to >INR 20b delivering only 16-17% Price CAGR.
data_needed: Base Market Cap, PAT CAGR, Price CAGR

title: motilal_wcs_18_2008_13.txt
rule: High RoE (>30%) Earnings Longevity Rule: High earnings power (RoE > 30%) wali companies me long position lo, chahe PAT growth moderate (14-15%) hi kyon na ho.
entry: Base year RoE > 30% wale stocks kharido.
exit: Jab trailing RoE < 20% gir jaye.
conditions: RoE > 30% companies delivered 21-24% Price CAGR despite modest PAT CAGR (14-15%), whereas RoE < 15% companies delivered lower stock returns (17% Price CAGR) despite high PAT CAGR (36%).
data_needed: RoE, Historical PAT CAGR, Stock Price CAGR

title: motilal_wcs_19_2009_14.txt
rule: 100x Multi-bagger SQGLP Stock Screening Rule: Select stocks with Market Cap <= Rs 3,000 Crore (INR 30 Billion / USD 0.5 Billion), Trailing P/E <= 25x, operating in Value Migration or Niche business model with high RoE.
entry: Buy stocks matching all criteria: Market Cap <= Rs 3,000 Crore, Trailing 12-month P/E <= 25x, operating in Value Migration (Global/Local) or Niche industry, low analyst coverage, and low institutional holding.
exit: Hold for multi-year compound expansion until earnings growth reverts to GDP growth mean or Competitive Advantage Period (CAP) ends.
conditions: Market Cap <= Rs 30 Billion; Trailing P/E <= 25x; Industry theme = Value Migration or Niche; High RoE (> cost of capital).
data_needed: Market Cap, Trailing P/E, Business description/sector classification, Institutional Holding %, RoE.

title: motilal_wcs_19_2009_14.txt
rule: Quality-Growth Matrix Filtering Rule: Avoid Quality Traps (Low Growth) and Growth Traps (Low RoE/Cyclical), and select only High-Quality + High-Growth small-cap stocks.
entry: Filter out stocks with RoE < Cost of Capital (Low Quality) and stocks with PAT CAGR < Nominal GDP Growth (Low Growth). Buy stocks with RoE > 20% AND Sales/PAT CAGR > 20% with Market Cap < Rs 3,000 Crore.
exit: Exit when PAT growth drops below GDP growth or RoE falls below Cost of Capital.
conditions: RoE > 20%, Sales/PAT CAGR > 20%, Market Cap < Rs 30 Billion.
data_needed: RoE, 3-5 Year Sales CAGR, 3-5 Year PAT CAGR, Market Cap.

title: motilal_wcs_19_2009_14.txt
rule: Market Cap to GDP Parity 2-Year Target Macro Rule: Buy broader market / index when Market Cap to GDP is <= 77% for a 2-year 50% market cap upside target.
entry: Initiate long position on Market Index when India Market Cap to GDP ratio drops to or below 77% (near 10-year average of 73%).
exit: Exit / book profit when Market Cap to GDP approaches 100% (parity with GDP) or after 2 years target period.
conditions: Market Cap to GDP ratio <= 77% (Historical 10-yr LPA = 73%, Peak = 103%). Target = 50% market upside over 2 years.
data_needed: Total Indian Stock Market Cap, India Annual Nominal GDP.

title: motilal_wcs_19_2009_14.txt
rule: Sensex Earnings Yield to Bond Yield Interest Rate Trigger Rule: Track Sensex Earnings Yield / 10-Year G-Sec Yield vs historical LPA of 0.85x to signal market upside momentum.
entry: When Sensex Earnings Yield / 10-Year G-Sec Yield ratio is below 0.85x (e.g. 0.76x), expect market upside to accelerate once 10-Year G-Sec yield drops / interest rates fall.
exit: number nahi diya
conditions: Sensex 1-year forward P/E Earnings Yield (1/PE) divided by 10-Year G-Sec Yield < 0.85x.
data_needed: Sensex 1-year forward P/E, 10-Year Indian G-Sec Yield.

title: motilal_wcs_19_2009_14.txt
rule: PSU Long Selection Filter: Only buy PSU stocks that match private sector benchmarks with 5-year Sales CAGR >= 17%, 5-year PAT CAGR >= 24%, and RoE >= 18%.
entry: Buy PSU stocks only when 5-year Sales CAGR >= 17%, 5-year PAT CAGR >= 24%, and RoE >= 18%.
exit: Exit PSU holding if 5-year PAT CAGR falls below 20% or RoE drops below 15%.
conditions: Filters out value-trap PSUs while allowing top performers in Oil & Gas and Financials.
data_needed: fundamentals (5-year Sales, PAT CAGR, and annual RoE)

title: motilal_wcs_19_2009_14.txt
rule: Small-Cap Price Acceleration Tier Filter: Prefer stocks with base Market Cap between INR 1 Billion to INR 25 Billion (Rs 100 Cr to Rs 2,500 Cr) for highest Price CAGR (51% avg).
entry: Filter universe for base Market Cap between Rs 100 Cr and Rs 2,500 Cr (INR 1-25 Billion) showing positive earnings acceleration.
exit: Trim/rebalance position when company transitions into large-cap (>Rs 10,000 Cr) or P/E re-rating plateaus.
conditions: Small-caps offer highest P/E re-rating upside due to initial market under-coverage.
data_needed: market cap and P/E historical data

title: motilal_wcs_19_2009_14.txt
rule: PAT CAGR Outperformance Target Filter: Filter for stocks with projected/historical 5-year PAT CAGR > 30% to capture 42%+ Price CAGR.
entry: Buy stocks demonstrating 5-year PAT CAGR > 30%.
exit: Exit when 5-year PAT CAGR slows down below 20%.
conditions: Avoid PAT CAGR < 10% stocks as Price CAGR drops to 25% with P/E de-rating risk.
data_needed: 5-year historical and projected PAT figures

title: motilal_wcs_19_2009_14.txt
rule: Structural Wealth Destroying Sector Avoidance Filter: Completely avoid long positions in Utilities, Capital Goods, Real Estate, Metals/Mining, and Telecom sectors during economic/policy slowdowns.
entry: Filter out and avoid buying stocks in Utilities, Capital Goods, Real Estate/Construction, Metals/Mining, and Telecom sectors.
exit: Exit immediately if a portfolio stock enters structural policy/cyclical headwinds in these sectors.
conditions: These 5 sectors caused over 55% of aggregate market wealth destruction.
data_needed: sector classification

title: motilal_wcs_20_2010_15.txt
rule: MQGLP Mid-to-Mega 6-Step Stock Selection Filter: Buy stocks ranked 101-300 in market cap with base RoE >= 20%, top 3 industry revenue leadership (or Value Migration beneficiary), preceding 2-year PAT CAGR >= 20%, secular model, and trailing P/E <= 25x; hold for 5 years targeting top 100 rank.
entry: Buy stocks ranked 101-300 by market cap meeting all 5 screening criteria: (1) Base RoE >= 20%, (2) Industry Revenue Rank #1, #2, or #3 OR Value Migration beneficiary, (3) Preceding 2-year PAT CAGR >= 20%, (4) Secular business model, (5) Trailing P/E <= 25x.
exit: Hold for 5 years or until market cap rank enters Top 100 / fundamentals degrade.
stop: Exit if annual RoE falls below 15% or trailing 2-year PAT CAGR drops below 0%.
conditions: Filters out cyclicals; requires top 3 market share by revenue or structural Value Migration theme.
data_needed: Market cap rankings (ranks 1-300), annual RoE, 2-year historical PAT CAGR, sector revenue rankings, trailing P/E ratio, 5-year OHLC data

title: motilal_wcs_20_2010_15.txt
rule: Quality Trap Avoidance Filter: Avoid buying or exit long positions in high RoE companies (> 20%) if trailing 3-to-5 year PAT CAGR is below 10% or below benchmark GDP/Sensex CAGR.
entry: Do not enter long positions if stock has RoE >= 20% but 3-year PAT CAGR < 10%. Exit existing long positions if trailing 3-year PAT CAGR falls below 10%.
exit: Exit immediately upon trailing 3-year PAT CAGR falling below 10%.
conditions: Applies to mature high-RoE companies facing growth saturation (e.g. Hero MotoCorp, Wipro, ACC).
data_needed: Annual RoE, 3-year and 5-year PAT CAGR, benchmark Sensex earnings growth data

title: motilal_wcs_20_2010_15.txt
rule: Mega-to-Mid Dropout Avoidance Rule: Avoid or sell Top 100 Market Cap stocks that are non-leaders (ranked 4th or lower in sector revenue) or belong to cyclical sectors entering earnings deceleration.
entry: Avoid entering or holding Top 100 market cap stocks if their industry revenue rank drops outside top 3 OR if cyclical sector PAT decelerates for 2 consecutive quarters.
exit: Sell stock immediately when industry revenue rank falls below 3rd position or cyclical earnings turn negative.
conditions: 75% of Mega-to-Mid dropouts are non-leaders; 35% of dropouts are caused by cyclical downturns.
data_needed: Top 100 Market cap rankings, quarterly sector revenue ranks, 2-quarter PAT growth trends

title: motilal_wcs_20_2010_15.txt
rule: Corporate Profit to GDP Macro Bottom Equities Accumulation Rule: Go aggressive long / overweight equities when Corporate Profit to GDP ratio drops below 4.0% and India Market Cap to GDP is below 76%.
entry: Increase broad equity allocation / go long broad index when India Corporate Profit to GDP ratio < 4.0% (historical average 5.0%) and Market Cap to GDP ratio < 76%.
exit: Reduce equity allocation when Corporate Profit to GDP ratio expands above 6.5%.
conditions: Corporate Profit / GDP < 4.0%, Market Cap / GDP < 76%.
data_needed: India Total Listed Corporate Net Profits, India Nominal GDP, Total India Market Capitalization

title: motilal_wcs_20_2010_15.txt
rule: Rising Profitability & De-leveraging Triad Screen: Buy companies showing simultaneous expansion of PAT Margin, stable Asset Turnover, and declining Debt-to-Equity with RoCE > G-Sec Yield
entry: Buy stocks meeting all 4 financial acceleration criteria upon annual report publication
exit: Exit when PAT margin declines for 2 consecutive years or gearing increases significantly to fund unprofitable expansion
stop: Trailing stop loss of 20% from peak or fundamental failure
conditions: PAT Margin (PAT/Sales) rising over 3-5 consecutive years AND Asset Turnover (Sales/Total Assets) stable or rising AND Gearing/Debt-to-Equity falling AND RoCE > prevailing G-Sec coupon rate
data_needed: annual financial statements (PAT, Sales, Total Assets, Total Debt, Equity, RoCE, G-Sec yield)

title: motilal_wcs_20_2010_15.txt
rule: Terms of Trade Working Capital Filter: Buy stocks with favorable Terms of Trade (Debtors to Creditors Ratio < 1.0)
entry: Filter and select stocks where Debtors / Creditors < 100% (Debtors < Creditors)
exit: Exit or reject when Debtors / Creditors ratio exceeds 1.5x (unfavorable working capital pressure)
conditions: Debtors / Creditors < 1.0 (indicates strong bargaining power with suppliers and customers)
data_needed: balance sheet data (Trade Receivables / Debtors, Trade Payables / Creditors)

title: motilal_wcs_20_2010_15.txt
rule: Commodity Cycle Squeeze Exit Rule: Sell commodity/cyclical stocks during the supply Squeeze phase when capacity utilization hits 100% and profits spike exponentially
entry: Enter commodity stocks during Recovery phase (moderate capacity utilization, rising product prices)
exit: Sell completely during Squeeze phase (near 100% capacity utilization, supply shortage, exponential profit surge) before fresh capacity creates Glut
stop: Trailing stop loss or exit on sign of aggressive industry-wide expansion announcements
conditions: Industry capacity utilization > 95% AND quarterly profit YoY growth > 100% in cyclical/commodity sectors (Metals, Mining, Chemicals)
data_needed: industry capacity utilization metrics, commodity spot prices, quarterly earnings data

title: motilal_wcs_20_2010_15.txt
rule: Winner Category Sector Selection Filter: Select sectors expected to grow revenue at >= 1.5x nominal GDP growth rate
entry: Overweight sectors whose projected annual revenue growth rate >= 1.5 * Projected Nominal GDP Growth
exit: Underweight or exit sector when sector growth slows below 1.0x nominal GDP growth
conditions: Sector Revenue Growth Rate >= 1.5 * Nominal GDP Growth Rate
data_needed: macroeconomic GDP projections, industry aggregate revenue growth estimates

title: motilal_wcs_20_2010_15.txt
rule: Global Commodity & PSU Wealth Destroyer Avoidance Filter: Exclude PSU commodity/metals/mining stocks from long-term portfolio allocation
entry: N/A (Filter out)
exit: Immediate liquidation if stock is a PSU operating in global commodities/cyclicals
conditions: Filter out companies with Government / PSU ownership > 50% AND operating in cyclical/global commodity sectors (Metals, Mining, Oil & Gas, Capital Goods)
data_needed: ownership shareholding pattern, sector classification

title: motilal_wcs_21_2011_16.txt
rule: Modified Kelly Formula Position Sizing: Long-term stock portfolio me position size fraction f = (Up - Dq) / U ke dwara tay karo, jahan U = Expected Upside %, p = Upside Probability, D = Expected Downside %, q = Downside Probability
entry: Jab Edge (Up - Dq) > 0 ho aur payoff asymmetric (High Upside vs Low Downside) ho
exit: Expected upside target achieve hone par ya fundamental downside thesis hit hone par
stop: D (Max estimated downside %) par stop-loss consider karo
conditions: Kelly fraction tabhi apply karo jab analytical edge available ho; subjective probabilities estimate karne ke liye robust fundamental research chahiye
data_needed: Historical price upside/downside distributions, target price estimates, fundamental win-loss probability ratios

title: motilal_wcs_21_2011_16.txt
rule: CAP (Confidence-Adjusted Payoff) Portfolio Weight Allocation: Portfolio ke 15-20 selected stocks ko CAP score (CAP = Projected 3-5 Year Upside % x Confidence Factor 0..100%) ke आधार par descend karke weighting assign karo
entry: CAP ranking ke top stocks ko maximum weight (up to 10%) do
exit: Jab stock ka CAP rank bottom me gir jaye ya confidence factor deflated ho jaye
conditions: Single stock max allocation <= 10%, Min stock allocation >= 3%, Max company equity stake <= 5%, total portfolio size 15-20 stocks across non-correlated sectors
data_needed: 3-5 year projected stock upside %, company confidence rating, total portfolio capital

title: motilal_wcs_21_2011_16.txt
rule: Focused Portfolio 15-20 Stock Optimal Risk-Diversification Rule: Maximum portfolio performance aur downside protection ke liye portfolio me exactly 15 se 20 non-correlated sector stocks rakho
entry: 15-20 high conviction QGLP stocks select karke enter karo
exit: Jab kisi stock ki thesis break ho to replacement stock se swap karo
conditions: 40+ stocks (over-diversification) avoid karo kyunki isse return benchmark ke barabar (modest) ho jata hai; < 10 stocks avoid karo high volatility ki wajah se
data_needed: Stock returns, stock correlation matrix, sector classification

title: motilal_wcs_21_2011_16.txt
rule: Mini-to-Mid Market Cap Crossover Momentum Screen: Base Market Cap < Rs 2,000 Crore (Market Cap rank > 300) wale small cap stocks jinme high PAT CAGR (> 30%) aur high scalable niche ho, unhe Top 101-300 rank target ke liye buy karo
entry: Base Market Cap < Rs 2,000 Crore, Market Cap rank > 300, 5-yr PAT CAGR > 30%, P/E < 20x
exit: Market Cap rank 101-300 reach karne par ya 5 saal baad
stop: PAT growth 15% se neeche girne par exit
conditions: Scalable niche (e.g. air coolers, tiles, pharma) ya large sector me dominant player ho
data_needed: Market cap ranking, PAT CAGR 5-year, P/E ratio, industry market size

title: motilal_wcs_21_2011_16.txt
rule: Mid-to-Mega Market Cap Crossover Strategy: Market Cap Rank 101 se 300 ke beech ke mid-cap stocks jinaka 5-year PAT CAGR > 20% aur RoE > 15% ho, unhe Top 100 Mega-cap rank migration ke liye buy karo
entry: Market Cap rank 101-300, 5-yr PAT CAGR > 20%, RoE > 15%
exit: Top 100 market cap category me enter hone ke baad target evaluation ya 5 saal holding
conditions: Mid-cap universe of 200 stocks se pick karo (historical baseline success rate 13%, average return 31% CAGR)
data_needed: Daily/Annual market cap rankings, historical 5-year PAT growth, RoE

title: motilal_wcs_21_2011_16.txt
rule: Consumer Discretionary Brand Compounding Consistency Screen: 10-saal ke track record par Consumer Discretionary brand companies (Asian Paints, Titan, Dabur) ko buy-and-hold karo jinaka 10-year Price CAGR >= 20% aur PAT CAGR >= 15% ho
entry: Consumer facing discretionary brand + 10-yr PAT CAGR >= 15% + RoE >= 20%
exit: Brand equity loss ya structural growth slowdown
conditions: Secular demand tailwind; valuation (P/E) agnostic buy-and-hold strategy
data_needed: 10-year financial metrics, PAT CAGR, RoE history, sector categorization

title: motilal_wcs_21_2011_16.txt
rule: Cyclical Commodities Earnings Peak Exit Rule: Metals, Mining, Oil & Gas, Capital Goods jaise cyclical sectors me earnings/commodity cycle ke peak par positions ko mandatory liquidate karo
market: sector / stocks (Metals, Mining, Oil & Gas, Capital Goods)
entry: Cyclical downturn ke bottom par jab earnings yield / valuation extreme low/distressed ho
exit: Commodity price peak / Peak earnings cycle par completely exit
stop: Earnings cycle reverse hote hi exit
conditions: Cyclicals me buy-and-hold long term ke liye mat karo; sell timing galat hone par 50-90% wealth destruction hota hai
data_needed: Global commodity prices, sector margins, quarterly PAT peak indicators

title: motilal_wcs_21_2011_16.txt
rule: Standalone Payback Ratio Valuation Screen: Buy stocks where Payback Ratio (Market Cap / Cumulative projected 5-year PAT) < 1.0x
entry: Payback ratio < 1.0x
exit: 5 saal baad ya Jab Payback ratio > 3.0x ho jaye
conditions: Cumulative 5-year projected PAT >= current market capitalization
data_needed: Market Cap, 5-year forward PAT projections

title: motilal_wcs_17_2007_12.txt
rule: 10-Year Sector-Relative RoE Moat Screening Rule: Select stocks with minimum 10-year history and Market Cap >= Rs 50 Crore whose RoE exceeds sector average RoE in at least 7 out of 10 years.
entry: Buy stocks satisfying RoE > sector average for >= 7 out of 10 years (or standalone consumer companies with high absolute RoE).
exit: Sell/Exit if annual RoE trend shows business model degradation near the investment period.
conditions: Market Cap >= Rs 50 Crore (INR 500m), 10-year financial data available, RoE > industry average in >= 7 of 10 years.
data_needed: fundamentals (annual company RoE, annual industry average RoE, market cap)

title: motilal_wcs_17_2007_12.txt
rule: 8-Year Sector-Relative RoE Moat Screening Rule: Select stocks with Market Cap >= Rs 50 Crore whose annual RoE exceeds sector average RoE in at least 6 out of 8 years.
entry: Buy companies matching 6 out of 8 years RoE > sector average criteria.
exit: Exit if business model deteriorates.
conditions: Market Cap >= Rs 50 Crore, 8-year financial history, RoE > industry average for >= 6 of 8 years.
data_needed: fundamentals (annual company RoE, industry average RoE, market cap)

title: motilal_wcs_17_2007_12.txt
rule: Sensex 10-Year Average P/E Market Entry Filter: Accumulate market index/broader equities when Sensex forward P/E is at or below its 10-year historical average of 14.8x.
entry: Buy Sensex / Nifty index ETF or broader market stocks when Sensex Forward P/E <= 14.8x.
exit: number nahi diya
conditions: Sensex Forward P/E <= 14.8x.
data_needed: daily Sensex price, consensus forward EPS estimates

title: motilal_wcs_17_2007_12.txt
rule: Corporate Profit to GDP Mean Reversion Equity Allocation Rule: Increase equity exposure when Corporate Profit to GDP ratio is near its 10-year historical average of 4.6% (range 4.5% - 5.0%).
entry: Go aggressive / overweight equities when Corporate Profit / GDP is near 4.6%.
exit: number nahi diya
conditions: Corporate Profit to GDP ratio around 4.5% - 5.0%.
data_needed: Total Corporate Profits aggregate, India Nominal GDP

title: motilal_wcs_17_2007_12.txt
rule: Market Cap to GDP Historical Mean Benchmark Rule: Benchmark broader equity valuation against 50% historical average Market Cap to GDP ratio and reduce exposure when approaching peak levels of 103%-115%.
entry: Buy index / equities when Total Market Cap to GDP ratio is near the 50% baseline average.
exit: Trim equity allocation when Market Cap to GDP reaches peak bubble band of 103% to 115%.
conditions: Baseline buy level: Market Cap / GDP ~ 50%; Target risk zone: 103% - 115%.
data_needed: Total Indian Stock Market Capitalisation, Annual Nominal GDP

title: motilal_wcs_22_2012_17.txt
rule: CAP (Competitive Advantage Period) Moat Screening Filter: Select companies maintaining annual RoE > 15% (Cost of Equity threshold) with Favorable Strategy in a Favorable Industry (Porter Score > 2.5)
entry: Buy stocks when RoE > 15% AND Porter Industry Score > 2.5 AND Corporate Strategy is Differentiated/Low-cost/Focus (F-F Quadrant)
exit: Exit or liquidate long positions when annual RoE drops below 15% (End of CAP) or when disruptive competition/capital misallocation degrades moat
conditions: RoE > 15%, Porter Five Forces Industry Score > 2.5, Strategy classified as Favorable (F-F or U-F quadrant)
data_needed: annual balance sheet, P&L, RoE, industry structural classification data

title: motilal_wcs_22_2012_17.txt
rule: GAP (Growth Advantage Period) Multi-Year Earnings Momentum Filter: Buy companies with 5-Year Rolling PAT CAGR > 15% and zero annual PAT declines
entry: Buy stocks where 5-year rolling PAT CAGR > 15% AND current year PAT > previous year PAT (no profit drop in any single year)
exit: Exit when 5-year rolling PAT CAGR drops below 15% or when any annual PAT drops year-on-year
stop: Annual YoY PAT decline or 5-year PAT CAGR < 15%
conditions: 5-Year Rolling PAT CAGR >= 15%, YoY PAT growth > 0% in every individual year during the holding period
data_needed: annual historical PAT data (minimum 5-year lookback)

title: motilal_wcs_22_2012_17.txt
rule: Porter's Five Forces Sector Selection & Exclusion Rule: Exclude sectors with total score <= 2.5; Long only in sectors with total score >= 3.0
entry: Filter universe for stocks operating in sectors with Porter Five Forces Score >= 3.0 (e.g. Cigarettes 5.0, Paints 5.0, FMCG 4.5, 2-Wheelers 4.0, Private Banks 3.0, Pharma 3.0, Cement 3.0)
exit: Completely avoid or exit all long positions in stocks belonging to sectors with Porter Score <= 2.5 (e.g. Capital Goods 2.0, Real Estate 2.0, Construction 1.5, Steel 2.0, Power 1.5, Telecom 3.0 if inter-firm rivalry spikes)
conditions: Each force (Rivalry, Entrants, Substitutes, Customer Power, Supplier Power) rated 0, 0.5, or 1. Total Score threshold = 2.5
data_needed: industry structural metrics (customer concentration, supplier concentration, switching costs, substitute penetration)

title: motilal_wcs_22_2012_17.txt
rule: CAP-GAP Confluence Outperformer Setup: Buy stocks matching CAP F-F/U-F + GAP H-H with PAT >= Rs 500 Crore
entry: Buy stocks meeting 3 criteria simultaneously: (1) RoE > 15% with Favorable Strategy (CAP F-F or U-F), (2) Industry PAT CAGR > 15% + High Growth Mindset (GAP H-H), and (3) Cumulative 20-year or trailing cumulative PAT >= INR 5 Billion (Rs 500 Crore)
exit: Exit when either RoE drops below 15% OR PAT growth falls below 15% for 2 consecutive years
conditions: RoE > 15%, Industry PAT CAGR > 15%, Company Strategy = Favorable, Growth Mindset = High (Aggressive capex, inorganic growth, or cost leverage), Min PAT >= Rs 500 Cr
data_needed: annual financial statements, industry growth data, strategic classification

title: motilal_wcs_22_2012_17.txt
rule: Cyclical vs Secular GAP Horizon & Exit Strategy: Restrict Cyclical High-GAP positions to max 5-6 years; Hold Secular High-GAP positions for 10-20 years
entry: Identify high-GAP stock setup (PAT CAGR > 35%). If business model is Cyclical (Metals, Mining, Cement, Real Estate, Auto Ancillaries), set maximum target horizon of 5-6 years. If Secular (FMCG, Private Banking, IT, Pharma), set target horizon to 10-20 years
exit: For Cyclicals: Exit mandatory after 5-6 years or at first sign of PAT growth deceleration below 15%. For Seculars: Hold as long as RoE > 15% and PAT CAGR > 15%
stop: PAT CAGR dropping below 15% in cyclicals; RoE < 15% in seculars
conditions: Classification of business as Cyclical vs Secular based on historical earnings volatility
data_needed: historical PAT series, industry classification

title: motilal_wcs_22_2012_17.txt
rule: Select companies with 20 consecutive years of RoE > 15% (20-Year CAP) AND 20 consecutive years of rolling 5-year PAT CAGR > 15% (20-Year GAP)
entry: Buy companies in financial/consumer sectors that have completed 5+ years of RoE > 15% and rolling 5-year PAT CAGR > 15%
exit: Exit on the first signs of capital misallocation or if RoE falls below 15%
stop: Annual RoE < 15% or 5-year rolling PAT CAGR < 15%
conditions: RoE > 15% for all years, rolling 5-year PAT CAGR > 15% for all years, strict underwriting/capital discipline
data_needed: 20-year annual financial data (RoE, PAT)

title: motilal_wcs_22_2012_17.txt
rule: GAP Longevity Filter with Strict Non-Declining PAT Rule: Select stocks with rolling 5-year PAT CAGR > 15% where no single year's PAT is lower than the previous year (PAT_t >= PAT_{t-1})
entry: Buy when rolling 5-year PAT CAGR > 15% AND annual PAT has increased YoY for 5 consecutive years
exit: Exit immediately if annual PAT declines YoY (PAT_t < PAT_{t-1}) or rolling 5-year PAT CAGR drops below 15%
stop: Any single year YoY PAT decline (PAT_t < PAT_{t-1})
conditions: Rolling 5-year PAT CAGR > 15%, 0 years of negative PAT growth in the evaluation window
data_needed: 5+ years of annual PAT figures

title: motilal_wcs_22_2012_17.txt
rule: Consumer Discretionary Brand Consistency Filter: Prefer Consumer Discretionary brand leaders over Consumer Staples for long-term compounding, requiring 10-year PAT CAGR > 15% and 10-year Price CAGR > 20%
entry: Buy market leaders in consumer discretionary (paints, jewellery, auto, retail) with 10-year average RoE > 20% and 10-year PAT CAGR > 15%
exit: Exit if 10-year PAT CAGR falls below 12% or pricing power/brand preference weakens
conditions: Sector = Consumer Discretionary (non-staple), 10-year PAT CAGR > 15%, 10-year RoE > 20%
data_needed: 10-year annual PAT, RoE, stock price history, sector classification

title: motilal_wcs_22_2012_17.txt
rule: Fastest Wealth Creator Small-Cap Scalability Screen: Buy stocks with Base Market Cap < Rs 2,000 Crore (INR 20 Billion), base P/E < 10x, operating in scalable sectors, with 5-year PAT CAGR > 30%
entry: Buy when Market Cap < Rs 2,000 Crore, Trailing P/E < 10x (or single digit P/E), operating in scalable sector (Pharma, Auto, Niche Retail/Consumer), and historical/projected 5-year PAT CAGR > 30%
exit: Exit after 5 years or when P/E expands above 35x / PAT growth slows below 15%
conditions: Base Market Cap < Rs 2,000 Cr, Base P/E < 10x, 5-year PAT CAGR > 30%
data_needed: Market Cap, Trailing P/E, 5-year PAT history

title: motilal_wcs_23_2013_18.txt
rule: Exuberant Valuation Sell / Portfolio Exit Signal: Sell or exit long positions in portfolio stocks if 3-Year Forward PEG > 3.0x OR P/E Relative to Market > 2.0x (whichever is higher).
entry: number nahi diya (Exit trigger)
exit: Exit position immediately when stock TTM P/E > 2x Market P/E OR 3-year forward PEG > 3.0x
conditions: Applies to existing long holdings, especially high-RoE low-growth quality trap stocks that have re-rated to exuberant valuation multiples.
data_needed: daily OHLC, TTM EPS, Nifty/Sensex P/E, projected 3-year PAT CAGR

title: motilal_wcs_23_2013_18.txt
rule: Core Business RoE Value Unlocking Screen: Buy cash-rich companies where Cash Equivalents > 40% of Net Worth (or > Rs 50 Billion) and Core Business RoE >= 30% while current P/E is modest (< 20x).
entry: Buy stock when Core Business RoE >= 30%, Cash/Net Worth > 40%, and trailing P/E <= 20x.
exit: Exit when company re-rates via dividend payout / buybacks or P/E reaches > 35x.
conditions: Core Business Net Worth = Net Worth - Cash Equivalents. Core Business PAT = Reported PAT - (4.5% * Cash Equivalents). Core Business RoE = Core Business PAT / Core Business Net Worth.
data_needed: Balance sheet Net Worth, Cash & Cash Equivalents, Annual PAT, Current Market Cap

title: motilal_wcs_23_2013_18.txt
rule: Porter's Five Forces Sectoral Attractiveness Filter: Only select stocks from sectors with a total Industry Structure Score >= 3.5 out of 5.0.
entry: Buy top-quality companies operating in sectors scoring >= 3.5 on Porter's Five Forces scale.
exit: Exit or avoid sectors scoring < 2.0 (e.g. Sugar, Cables, Textiles, Power, Logistics, Shipping).
conditions: Score 5 forces (Rivalry, Bargaining Power of Customers, Bargaining Power of Suppliers, Threat of Entrants, Threat of Substitutes) on 0, 0.5, 1 scale based on competitive dynamic.
data_needed: Industry sector classification, competitive market share data

title: motilal_wcs_23_2013_18.txt
rule: Hyper-Growth Duration Exhaustion Exit Rule: Exit or reduce position in hyper-growth stocks (PAT CAGR >= 25%) when high-growth duration reaches 5 to 6 years.
entry: Buy high-growth stock at start of earnings acceleration cycle.
exit: Sell or trim position after 5 consecutive years of >= 25% PAT growth, as historical probability of sustaining 25%+ growth into 2nd/3rd 5-year block drops below 28%.
conditions: Applies to stocks experiencing > 25% earnings CAGR over a 5-year period.
data_needed: Annual PAT data for last 5-10 years

title: motilal_wcs_23_2013_18.txt
rule: Cost of Equity Value Creation Hurdle Filter: Avoid long positions in companies whose 5-year average RoE is <= 13% (Cost of Equity threshold).
entry: Screen out and reject any stock with 5-year average RoE <= 13%.
exit: Exit if 3-year rolling average RoE falls below 13%.
conditions: Assumed Cost of Equity = 13% (8% Risk-Free Rate + 5% Equity Risk Premium). Growth creates zero or negative intrinsic value when RoE <= 13%.
data_needed: Annual Net Worth, PAT, 10-Year G-Sec yield

title: motilal_wcs_23_2013_18.txt
rule: Consumer-Facing Consistency Filter: For multi-year consistent wealth creation portfolios, select only consumer-facing companies (Consumer & Retail, Auto, Consumer Financials, Consumer Healthcare) and exclude B2B/cyclical stocks.
entry: Buy consumer-facing companies appearing in mid-to-large market cap ranks with strong earnings stability.
exit: Exit if business pivots away from direct consumer model or P/E re-rating reaches unsustainable extreme levels.
conditions: Must be 100% consumer-facing business model; 10-year earnings track record.
data_needed: fundamentals / sector classification / historical financial data

title: motilal_wcs_23_2013_18.txt
rule: Monopolistic PSU Long Selection Rule: Only buy/hold Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) that operate as near-monopolies or receive government-nominated orders with minimal private sector competition (e.g., Oil Marketing Companies, Power Grid, GAIL, IGL, BEL, NBCC); strictly avoid PSUs competing directly with private players.
entry: Buy monopolistic PSUs showing PAT CAGR >= 20% and trading at low/reasonable P/E.
exit: Exit when government policy introduces direct private competition or earnings growth stalls.
conditions: PSU must have >= 70% market share or state-sanctioned monopoly / monopoly infrastructure / nominated contracts.
data_needed: fundamentals / market share data / government policy information

title: motilal_wcs_23_2013_18.txt
rule: Fastest Multi-bagger Small-Cap Screen: Screen for stocks with Base Market Cap < INR 20 Billion (Rs 2,000 Crore) AND Base P/E < 10x with positive future PAT growth.
entry: Buy stocks satisfying Market Cap < Rs 2,000 Cr and Trailing P/E < 10x.
exit: Sell/lock profits when valuation re-rating drives P/E to unsustainable high levels (leaving no margin of safety) or 5-year target achieved.
conditions: Market Cap < INR 20 Billion (Rs 2,000 Cr); Trailing P/E < 10x.
data_needed: daily closing prices / market cap / trailing EPS / P/E ratios

title: motilal_wcs_23_2013_18.txt
rule: Banking Sector Value Migration Pair Rule: Allocate long capital exclusively to private sector banks and NBFCs, while avoiding or shorting state-owned (PSU) banks to capture structural market share transfer.
entry: Go long private sector banks (e.g., HDFC Bank, Kotak Bank, IndusInd) / NBFCs (e.g., Bajaj Finance) and short/avoid PSU banks (e.g., Bank of India, PNB, SBI).
exit: Exit pair trade when PSU bank NPA cycle reverses and credit market share loss stops.
conditions: Private bank credit growth > PSU bank credit growth; asset quality metrics superior in private banks.
data_needed: financial sector metrics / bank balance sheets / market share data

title: motilal_wcs_24_2014_19.txt
rule: Forensic Avoid/Sell Signal: Statutory Auditor Resignation Trigger
entry: NA (Exit / Short signal)
exit: Auditor ke resignation announcement ke turant baad complete exit / sell out
conditions: Statutory auditor term khatam hone se pehle mid-tenure resign kare ya accounts par adverse/disclaimer remarks de (jaise Manpasand Beverages me Deloitte resignation ke baad 90%+ crash)
data_needed: corporate announcements / regulatory filings

title: motilal_wcs_24_2014_19.txt
rule: Forensic Quality Screen: OCF to PAT Conversion Ratio Filter
entry: Sirf wahi stocks hold/buy karo jahan 3-year cumulative OCF / 3-year cumulative PAT >= 0.70 (70%)
exit: Agar PAT positive aur growing ho lekin 3-year cumulative OCF negative ho ya OCF/PAT < 0.50 ho jaye to exit
conditions: Manufacturing, FMCG aur services sector me lagao (financials/lending par lagu nahi). Bogus billing pakadne ke liye OCF/PAT correlation zaroori hai.
data_needed: fundamentals (Cash Flow from Operations, PAT)

title: motilal_wcs_24_2014_19.txt
rule: Fraud & Stress Triad Filter: High Debtor Days + Anemic Tax Rate + Negative OCF Avoid Rule
entry: NA (Negative screening rule - completely avoid / reject)
exit: Immediate exit agar trailing financial year me ye teeno shartein mil jayein
conditions: (1) Trade Receivable Days > 150 days AND (2) Effective Corporate Tax Rate < 15% (single digit tax rate) AND (3) Annual Operating Cash Flow < 0, jabki reported PAT positive ho (jaise Gitanjali Gems model)
data_needed: fundamentals (Balance sheet debtors, P&L tax expense and PBT, Cash flow OCF)

title: motilal_wcs_24_2014_19.txt
rule: Hidden Leverage & Contingent Liability Trap Filter
entry: NA (Avoid rule)
exit: Exit long positions agar Free Cash Flow lagatar 3 saal negative ho aur Contingent Liabilities / Net Worth > 25% ho
conditions: (1) Free Cash Flow (OCF minus Capex) negative for >= 3 consecutive years AND (2) Contingent liabilities (guarantees given, discounted bills with recourse) tezi se badhkar Net Worth ke 25% se zyada ho jayein (jaise Educomp model)
data_needed: fundamentals (Free Cash Flow, Contingent Liabilities, Net Worth)

title: motilal_wcs_24_2014_19.txt
rule: Fastest Wealth Creator Midcap Screen: Trailing P/E < 12x + Market Cap < Rs 3,000 Crore
entry: Buy companies with Market Cap < Rs 3,000 Crore (INR 30 Billion) AND Trailing 12-month P/E < 12x
exit: 5 saal holding period ya P/E valuation extreme expansion (> 45x P/E)
stop: Forensic red flag / auditor resignation / governance issue aane par exit
conditions: Motilal Oswal study data: 2014-19 ke top 10 fastest wealth creators me se 80% stocks ka base year P/E < 12x tha aur 70% ka market cap < INR 30 billion tha. High management integrity hona shart hai.
data_needed: fundamentals (Market Cap, Trailing P/E)

title: motilal_wcs_24_2014_19.txt
rule: PEG < 0.5x Valuation Acceleration Screen: Trailing P/E divided by 5-year PAT CAGR <= 0.5x hone par stock me buy long position lo.
entry: Buy stocks where Trailing P/E / 5-Year PAT CAGR < 0.5x
exit: Exit when PEG ratio expands > 1.5x or 5-year holding period completes
conditions: Trailing 12M P/E ko 5-year PAT CAGR se divide karne par ratio < 0.5 hona chahiye; PAT growth positive honi chahiye
data_needed: Daily OHLC, annual PAT figures for 5 years, trailing 12-month P/E

title: motilal_wcs_24_2014_19.txt
rule: Private Entrepreneur Market Cap Ownership Filter: Long-term portfolio selection me MNCs aur PSUs ko filter out karke sirf Indian Private Entrepreneur-promoted companies me buy position banao.
entry: Screen for listed Indian private promoter-driven stocks (exclude PSU and MNC multinationals)
exit: Exit if promoter ownership shifts to government/PSU or MNC restructuring
conditions: Promoter ownership must be Indian Private Entrepreneurs (market cap share expanded from 47% to 73%); PSU and MNC share reduced to 14% each
data_needed: Shareholding pattern, promoter classification (PSU, MNC, Private Indian)

title: motilal_wcs_24_2014_19.txt
rule: Virtual Monopoly PSU Exception Selection Filter: General PSUs ko avoid karo, lekin sirf unhi PSUs me buy position banao jo pure 'Virtual Monopoly' hain (jaise Oil Marketing Companies, Power Grid Utilities).
entry: Buy PSU stocks that hold virtual monopoly status / near zero private competition in their sector
exit: Exit when deregulation occurs or private sector competition enters
conditions: Company must be a PSU with virtual monopoly in strategic infrastructure/OMC sectors
data_needed: Sector market share data, PSU business description

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: 25-for-25 Mid-Cap Wealth Creator Screening Screen: Kharido un mid-cap shares ko jo 8 quantitative aur qualitative filters ko pass karein.
entry: Screening filters par pass hone wale stocks me buy karein: (1) Current Market Cap rank 101 se 250 (Mid-caps), (2) Exclude cyclical sectors (Auto ancillaries, Cap Goods, Chemicals, Oil & Gas, Realty), (3) 5-Year Average RoE > 15%, (4) Business & Management potential pass, (5) Industry Top 3 Market Leaders ya Value Migration beneficiaries, (6) Large-cap Financial Leaders ya Pure Digital Plays.
exit: number nahi diya
conditions: Market Cap Rank 101-250, 5-Year Avg RoE > 15%, non-cyclical consumer-facing/secular business model.
data_needed: Market Cap Rank, 5-year average RoE, sectoral classification, market share/leadership data

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: 3-Year Rolling Outperformance Consistency Screen (Consistent Wealth Creator Filter): Minimum 65% (>=15 out of 23) rolling 3-year periods me Sensex ko outperform karne wale stocks pick karo.
entry: Pichle 25 saal ke 23 rolling 3-year windows (1995-98, 1996-99, ..., 2017-20) me check karo; jin stocks ne benchmark Sensex ko >=15 rolling windows me outperform kiya ho aur 25-year Price CAGR > benchmark (9.2%) ho, unme allocation karo.
exit: number nahi diya
conditions: Rolling 3-year benchmark outperformance count >= 15 out of 23.
data_needed: Stock daily/monthly price data, Sensex benchmark historical data, 3-year rolling CAGR calculation

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: Combined All-Round Wealth Creator Scoring Model: Fastest, Biggest aur Consistent ranks ke minimum combined sum par stock portfolio select karo.
entry: Har stock ka 3 criteria par rank nikalo: (1) Price CAGR rank (Fastest), (2) Net Wealth Created in absolute INR rank (Biggest), (3) 3-year rolling outperformance count rank (Consistent). Teeno ranks ke sum (Total Rank) ko calculate karke sabse kam sum wale top 25 stocks ko portfolio me buy karo.
exit: number nahi diya
conditions: Total Rank = Fastest Rank + Biggest Rank + Consistent Rank. Lowest Total Rank selected.
data_needed: Historical price CAGR, Market cap change adjusted for corporate actions, 3-year rolling return history

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: 25-Year Sector RoE > 13% Persistence Filter: Long-term compounding ke liye sirf unhi sectors me long position lo jinka 25-year history me har saal RoE > 13% raha ho.
entry: Long-term investment ke liye exclusively Consumer/Retail, IT aur Paints sectors ke leaders ko select karo; un sectors ko reject karo jinka sector RoE persistent nahi hai ya economic cycle me <= 13% par gir jata hai.
exit: Sector RoE < 13% girne par exit karein.
conditions: Sector annual average RoE consistently > 13% across all 25 years.
data_needed: Sectoral financial metrics, annual sector average RoE data

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: Market Cap to GDP >= 100% Froth Trigger: Broad equity index longs avoid karo jab India Market Cap to GDP 100% ke upar chala jaye.
entry: Nifty/Sensex index longs ya broad market exposure reduce karo jab Total Market Cap / Nominal GDP >= 100% (long-term historical average 60%).
exit: Market Cap / GDP >= 100% hone par index long positions se exit karo ya leverage clear karo.
conditions: India Market Cap to GDP >= 100%.
data_needed: Total Indian Listed Market Capitalization, India Nominal GDP numbers

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: Du Pont Triad 5-Year Outperformance Screen: Kharido un stocks ko jinka 5-year PAT Margin badha ho, Asset Turnover badha ho aur Financial Leverage < 2.0 (Debt/Equity <= 1.0) ho.
entry: Screening filter run karo top 500 market-cap stocks par: PAT Margin_t > PAT Margin_{t-5} AND Asset Turnover_t > Asset Turnover_{t-5} AND Leverage_t < 2.0 (Debt/Equity <= 1.0). In stocks me long position banao.
exit: Jab PAT Margin ya Asset Turnover me 5-year trend me giravat aaye ya Leverage 2.0 se upar chala jaaye.
stop: number nahi diya (Fundamental score degradation / rank breach par exit)
conditions: Leverage (Total Assets / Net Worth) < 2.0, Debt to Equity <= 1.0, 5-saal ke interval par dono margin aur asset efficiency me positive growth mandatory.
data_needed: 5-year historical balance sheet and P&L (PAT, Sales, Total Assets, Net Worth, Total Debt)

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: Emergence Stage RoE Cross-Over Trigger (RoE > 13% Turnaround Setup): Buy companies when RoE crosses above the 13% Cost of Equity floor for the first time ever or after a multi-year gap.
entry: Buy when annual Return on Equity (RoE) crosses > 13% from a previous level of < 13% (or negative), backed by industry value migration or unique value proposition.
exit: Exit if RoE drops back below 13% continuously for 2 consecutive financial years.
conditions: Company operating in a secular/value migration sector; positive operating cash flow (OCF > 0); no high promoter share pledging.
data_needed: Annual Net Profit, Net Worth, RoE historical series

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: Common-Size Operating Efficiency Screen (Employee Cost Ratio Structural Reduction): Select companies showing a continuous multi-year drop in Employee Cost as % of Net Sales, resulting in EBITDA margin expansion > 5 percentage points.
entry: Buy stocks where Employee Cost / Net Sales has dropped by >= 500 bps over a 3 to 5-year period (e.g., from >20% down to <15%) while Sales are growing, driving EBITDA margin up by > 5 percentage points.
exit: Exit when EBITDA margin peaks and Employee Cost % of Sales begins rising for 2 consecutive years.
conditions: Common-size P&L analysis shows fixed cost rationalization; Sales revenue growth remains positive.
data_needed: Common-size Income Statement (Employee Expenses, Net Sales, EBITDA)

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: Winner Category + Category Winner Entry Model (Sector CAGR >= 1.5x Nominal GDP & P/E <= 21x): Buy category leaders in consolidated sectors growing at >= 1.5x nominal GDP growth when stock P/E is <= 21x.
entry: Identify sectors with 5-year projected revenue CAGR >= 1.5x nominal GDP CAGR and Porter Sector Structure Score >= 3.0. Buy market leader (Category Winner) when trailing P/E <= 21x.
exit: Exit when sector revenue growth falls below nominal GDP growth OR stock valuation becomes excessively exuberant (P/E > 2.5x industry average).
conditions: Industry must be consolidated (top 3-4 players hold majority share); strong competitive moat present.
data_needed: Nominal GDP CAGR estimates, Sector revenue growth rates, Stock P/E ratio, Market share metrics

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: Gruesome Sector Exclusion & Hard Avoidance Rule: Completely exclude long positions in companies with RoE < 13% combined with high annual Capex / capital intensity.
entry: Avoid / Short filter: Do not enter long positions in companies where 5-year average RoE < 13% AND Net Capital Expenditure / Operating Cash Flow > 1.0 (capital guzzler / Gruesome business like airlines, legacy telecom, power generation).
exit: Immediate exit from long portfolio if 3-year trailing average RoE drops < 13% alongside high capital deployment.
conditions: RoE consistently below Cost of Equity (13%) + persistent negative Free Cash Flow (FCF < 0).
data_needed: RoE history, Operating Cash Flow, Capex data

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: Intrinsic P/E Formula Rule: Stock Intrinsic P/E = Dividend Payout Ratio / (k - g), buy when Market P/E < Intrinsic P/E
entry: Market P/E < Intrinsic P/E (calculated via Dividend Payout Ratio / (Cost of Equity k - Perpetual Growth g))
exit: Market P/E >= Intrinsic P/E or fundamentals deteriorate
conditions: Dividend Payout Ratio known, k (cost of equity) and g estimated conservatively
data_needed: fundamentals (Dividend Payout Ratio, Cost of Equity, Growth Rate, Current P/E)

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: Deep Value P/B < 1.0x 5-Year Outperformance Filter
entry: Buy stocks with Price-to-Book Ratio (P/B) < 1.0x
exit: Hold for 5 years or exit when P/B expands to fair value
conditions: Trailing Price / Book Value < 1.0x
data_needed: daily OHLC, book value per share

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: Stock-to-Market Relative P/E Valuation Filter: Buy Stock P/E / Market P/E < 1.0x, Avoid/Exit if > 2.0x
entry: Stock Trailing P/E / Market Index Trailing P/E < 1.0x
exit: Relative P/E > 2.0x (generates negative alpha -8%)
conditions: Stock trades at a discount to broader market index P/E
data_needed: fundamentals (Stock P/E, Market Index P/E)

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: Mega Overseas Acquisition Avoidance / Exit Rule: Avoid/Exit stocks undertaking large foreign acquisitions
entry: Avoid long positions or short on announcement of mega cross-border acquisition
exit: 3 years post-acquisition completion
conditions: Indian company acquires large overseas entity (historical 3-year return CAGR muted/negative -11% to -33%)
data_needed: corporate news / M&A announcements, price history

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: Large Unpopular Deregulation Turnaround Setup: Revenue > Rs 2 Trillion + Market Cap < Rs 100 Billion (P/S < 0.05x) + Policy Deregulation Catalyst
entry: Buy large-cap stock (Annual Revenue > Rs 2 Trillion, Market Cap < Rs 100 Billion) when government price control deregulation or key policy headwind is officially removed
exit: 3-4 years holding period or valuation re-rating
conditions: Annual Revenue > INR 2,000 Billion, Market Cap < INR 100 Billion, P/S < 0.05x, Price deregulation news catalyst
data_needed: fundamentals (Revenue, Market Cap), regulatory policy announcements

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: Mid-to-Mega MQGLP Selection Twist: Market Cap Rank 101-250 + Sector Top-3 Market Leadership Rank
entry: Select mid-cap stocks with Market Cap Rank between 101 and 250 that rank in the top 3 by market share in their respective industry sector
exit: Crossover into Top 100 Mega Market Cap rank or 5 years
conditions: Market Cap Rank 101 to 250, Sector Leadership Rank <= 3, MQGLP compliant
data_needed: market cap rankings, sector market share data, QGLP fundamentals

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: 100x SQGLP Market Cap Upper Bound Limit: Base Market Cap <= INR 75 Billion (US$ 1 Billion)
entry: Filter stocks with Base Market Cap <= INR 75 Billion (Rs 7,500 Crore / US$ 1 Billion) matching Quality, Growth, Longevity, Price criteria
exit: Multi-year target or fundamental exhaustion
conditions: Market Cap <= INR 75 Billion (USD 1 Billion)
data_needed: market cap data, QGLP fundamental screens

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: B2C Revenue Resiliency Filter: Prefer B2C Business Models over B2B/B2G to Avoid Cyclical Wealth Destruction
entry: Select companies generating predominant revenue (> 70%) from B2C (business-to-consumer) segment; avoid B2B/B2G cyclical companies
exit: Business model shift to B2B/B2G
conditions: Consumer-facing B2C business model
data_needed: segmental revenue breakdown from financial reports

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: DCF / Valuation Formula: Calculate Intrinsic Share Value = C * (RoC - G) / (R - G), where C = Capital Employed, RoC = Return on Capital Employed, G = Growth in Capital Employed, R = Cost of Capital
entry: Buy stock when current market price is at a significant discount (Margin of Safety) to calculated Value = C * (RoC - G) / (R - G)
exit: Exit when market price reaches or exceeds intrinsic value
conditions: RoC must be greater than R (Cost of Capital); G (Growth rate in Capital) must be less than R to prevent infinite valuation
data_needed: fundamentals (Capital Employed, RoCE, Capital Growth rate, Cost of Capital)

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: DuPont Wealth Creator Triad Filter: Select stocks with rising PAT Margin (PAT/Sales), stable Asset Turnover (Sales/Assets), falling Gearing (Assets/Equity), and RoCE > G-Sec coupon rate
entry: Buy when annual financial results show expanding PAT margin combined with declining debt/gearing and RoCE significantly higher than bond yield
exit: Exit when PAT margins start contracting or financial leverage/gearing starts increasing to fund growth
conditions: RoCE > prevailing coupon rate; expansion funded purely via internal accruals
data_needed: fundamentals (annual/quarterly P&L and balance sheet ratios)

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: Most Consistent Wealth Creator Screen: Buy market leader stocks in non-cyclical, consumer-facing sectors with consistently high Return on Equity (RoE)
entry: Buy market leaders in non-cyclical consumer sectors when valuation is reasonable
exit: Exit if market leadership rank drops or business enters cyclical decline
conditions: Company must be #1 or #2 leader in its segment, consumer-facing, non-cyclical, with high RoE
data_needed: fundamentals, sector classification, market share data

title: motilal_wcs_25_2015_20.txt
rule: Blue Chip 6-Filter Shortlist & Dual Entry Signal Strategy
entry: Buy shortlisted blue chip when (1) Dividend Yield > 10-year median AND P/E < 10-year median OR (2) Dividend Yield > 3.0%
exit: Exit or reduce allocation when stock becomes extremely overvalued

title: motilal_wcs_26_2016_21.txt

title: motilal_wcs_26_2016_21.txt

title: motilal_wcs_26_2016_21.txt

entry: Kharido un stocks ko jinone pichle 5 rolling saalon me se kam se kam 4 saal Sensex ke annual percentage return ko beat kiya ho.
exit: Exit ya rebalance karo jab stock lagataar 2 saal benchmark ko beat karne me asamarth rahe.
conditions: Base year Market Cap >= Rs 500 Crore (INR 5 Billion); price CAGR > benchmark Sensex 5-year CAGR (14.3%).

entry: Calculate Composite Rank = Rank(Wealth Created) + Rank(Price CAGR) + Rank(Consistency Years). Portfolio me lowest sum of ranks wale top 15-20 stocks ko buy karo.
exit: 5 saal ke baad rebalance karo ya tab exit karo jab composite rank sum bottom 50% me gir jaaye.

title: motilal_wcs_26_2016_21.txt

exit: Exit immediately if 5-year price CAGR drops below benchmark CAGR.
conditions: Stock 5-Year Price CAGR < Sensex 5-Year Price CAGR (14.3%).
data_needed: stock 5-year price CAGR, Sensex 5-year price CAGR

title: motilal_wcs_26_2016_21.txt

title: motilal_wcs_27_2017_22.txt

title: motilal_wcs_27_2017_22.txt

exit: Long-term compounding buy-and-hold; exit only if earnings consistency breaks or valuation becomes exuberantly stretched.
stop: Fundamental degradation or breakdown of earnings consistency rule.
conditions: Stock must be classified as Consistent; Current P/E < 10-Year Median P/E.
data_needed: Daily P/E history (10 years), annual PAT data

exit: Exit after 3 years or when PAT drops by > 10% in any annual reporting.

conditions: Outperformed benchmark annual return in >= 4 out of 5 trailing years

exit: Exit or remove stock from portfolio when company enters Economic Loss (RoE < 10% / EP < 0).
conditions: Trailing RoE > 10%; Cost of Equity (CoE) assumed at 10%; EP = PAT - (Net Worth * 10%).

title: motilal_wcs_28_2018_23.txt

entry: Buy stocks with PEP-G <= 2.0x (where PEP = Market Cap / Economic Profit, and EP = PAT - 0.10 * Net Worth). Prefer PEP-G <= 1.0x for highest returns.
exit: Sell or trim when PEP-G > 4.0x or EP CAGR decelerates below 10%.
conditions: PEP-G <= 2.0x (PEP-G <= 1.0x yields 33% CAGR; PEP-G 1.0-2.0x yields 27% CAGR).
data_needed: Market Cap, Annual PAT, Net Worth, Historical/Projected EP CAGR

exit: Sell when P/E expands by >= 2x or 10-year EP CAGR drops below 15%.

conditions: Listing history >= 10 saal; Market Cap Rank Top 50 OR (Top 250 + 10-Yr Avg RoE >= 20%); Drawdown >= 50% from 5-Year High; P/B <= 2.0x
data_needed: Daily/Weekly OHLC, 5-Year High Price, Market Cap Rank history, 10-Year RoE history, Trailing P/B ratio

data_needed: Annual Reports, Segmental Financial Data, Management Guidance & Restructuring announcements

title: motilal_wcs_29_2019_24.txt

entry: Base year me loss-making (Negative P/E) ya Negative Net Worth wali company me entry lo jab operational turnaround signal (debt cut > 50%, capacity utilization ramp-up) dikhai de.
exit: 5 saal ke holding period par rebalance karo ya jab P/E re-rating fully price in ho jaye.
stop: Operational cash flow negative bane rehne par ya debt fir se peak levels par pahunchne par exit.
conditions: Base year P/E = Loss-making ya P/B = Negative NW; 5-year PAT growth L-to-Profit turnaround.
data_needed: 5-year historical P&L (PAT), Balance Sheet (Net Debt, Net Worth), P/E ratio, P/B ratio.

Additional GDP Growth % = (Wealth Effect Spending / Base Nominal GDP) * 100; 4. Signal: Additional GDP Growth >= 0.4% hone par equity portfolio aggressive tilt karo.

conditions: 1. Select Consumer Durables sectors targeting projected 20% sales CAGR; 2. Filter out or underweight Non-Durables/Food/FMCG necessities jinka projected CAGR 8% (nominal GDP se kam) hai.

exit: Exit when price closes below the invalidation support level.
